from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions
from taggit.models import TaggedItem
from .models import EnterpriseDocument
from .serializers import EnterpriseDocumentBriefSerializer

class TaggedDocumentListView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, tag_slug):
        # Scope document query to the authenticated user's organization
        documents = EnterpriseDocument.objects.filter(
            organization=request.user.organization,
            tags__slug=tag_slug
        ).distinct()
        serializer = EnterpriseDocumentBriefSerializer(documents, many=True)
        return Response({"tag": tag_slug, "results": serializer.data})
